summary: Wire #660 PM apply cycles to #644 fleet: on delegated assignments, handoff_from_pm_assignment opens durable handoffs (budget-aware); report.fleet_handoffs + assignment.fleet_handoff_id; dispatch_fleet flag on run_cycle/loop.
migration_impact: Non-dry-run plate_pm_run_cycle / run_pm_cycle now create fleet handoffs by default (dispatch_fleet=True). Dry-run unchanged. Pass dispatch_fleet=false to disable. Handoffs land under .agentic/fleet/ (or fleet_base_dir in tests).
migration_guidance: 2. Prefer dry_run first; then --apply / dry_run=false to open handoffs.
3. Inspect report.fleet_handoffs and gh plate fleet --list.
4. Accept blocked high-risk handoffs via plate_fleet_update before execution.
agent_notes: dry_run never opens fleet handoffs. Budget remaining is passed into handoff create. If fleet budget-blocks, assignment status becomes blocked.
